scientific_integrity: Both one-sided ideal implications are proved independently from the action of the ordinary group identity under transported multiplication. The standalone finite verifier supplements the general proof and does not certify infinitely many parameters.
scientific_limitations: Only cyclic underlying groups of odd prime-power order, field characteristic equal to that prime, and Latin multipliers; no claims about non-Latin, mixed-order, or noncyclic cases. The group-ring transport and augmentation formulas are credited to prior literature. No independent validation performed.
title: Uniserial ideal structure of cyclic modular Latin Alexander quandle algebras
